header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Sikander Ali Kolachi advocate for the petitioner.
body: Mr. Neel Parkash, D.P.G a/w ASP Haq Nawaz Odho SDPO Shahdadpur, Mr. Zakarya DSP Legal Sanghar, Inspector Muhammad Hanif S.H.O P.S Shahdadpur, APS Muhammad Najam-us-Saqib and SIP Muhammad Rashid (on behalf of respondent No.8).
Learned A.A.G has filed report on behalf of the S.S.P, Sanghar, which is taken on record.

It is admitted by learned counsel for the petitioner and official respondents that this case is of enforced disappearance person and the S.S.P, Sanghar, has also sent letter to the Commission of Inquiry on Enforced Disappearance Person for further proceedings. Under these circumstances, this petition is disposed of with direction to the S.S.P, Sanghar, to refer the matter to the Commission of Inquiry on Enforced Disappearance Person and said Commission shall take serious efforts for recovery of allegedly missing person namely Shakeel Ahmed s/o Ibrahim.
